scope: F07 order, visibility and labels; related collection/identity research with explicit remaining live model obligations

mapping_decisions.J01: Byte operation options are camelCase; neutral live method/property spellings remain planned and are not renamed by this operation API.
mapping_decisions.J02: Name/ID index records are immutable snapshots; not live Slide objects. IDs remain exact through move. Names are labels and may repeat.
mapping_decisions.J03: Operation positions explicitly declare one/zero-based coordinates; CLI destination is final one-based block position. Live collection .at/.slice/protocols and .get default semantics remain planned.
mapping_decisions.J06: mutateSlides always async, explicit bytes/stream/VFS authority; no ambient I/O.
mapping_decisions.J07: No implicit clock, network, native runtime, content evaluation or notes creation.
mapping_decisions.J08: Operation usage errors invalid-value/invalid-selection differ from planned model IndexError/ValueError. Missing lookup is missing-selection. Null label rejection is operation-only; model null-clearing still required.
mapping_decisions.J09: Reordering owned XML children retains exact node markup under same parent; rejects foreign, duplicate and incomplete permutations. No unrestricted XML library surface.
mapping_decisions.J10: slides.move/slides.set direct flags and validated selection JSON mirror byte operation; generic method evaluation is absent.

documentation_drift: Published/pinned version drift remains recorded in upstream-api-audit.md.
follow_master_background documented setter missing from pinned implementation remains an explicit future target obligation; this increment does not advertise it.

Historical audit status says SDK implementation not started. That remains true for the mirrored live object model; byte-operation and command evidence now exists. This supplemental receipt does not rewrite unrelated canonical research statuses.
Advanced ordered selection is exposed through additive --selection-json and runtime schema; --slide remains a scalar. Draft usage documents that extension.
